test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who founded the city of Agra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikander Lodhi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Sikander Lodhi**

__
 
• He was a **Pashtun Sultan of the Delhi Sultanate between 1489 and 1517.**
 
• He expanded Lodi's rule into the regions of** Gwalior and Bihar.**
 
• He founded Agra in the year **1504.**
 
• The last king of Agra was **Sultan Ibrahim Lodhi(1517-1526).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **Alam Shah**

 
• He was the **fourth and last ruler** of the **Sayyid dynasty** which ruled the **Delhi Sultanate.**
 
• An** orthodox Sunni Muslim, **spent his time reading the **Quran.**
 
• He also spread** Islam in his Kindom**.

**Ibrahim Lodhi**

 
• His father was **Sikander Lodhi**.
 
• He was the** last sultan of the Delhi Sultanate.**
 
• In **1526, first battle of Panipat**, he was defeated and killed by the **Mughal forces of Babur.**

**Bahlol Lodhi**

 
• He was the** chief of the Pashtun Lodi tribe**.
 
• Founder of the** Lodi dynasty from the Delhi Sultanate**.
 
• Bahlul became **sultan of the dynasty on 19 April 1451.**
